title: Potential IndexError when no prior span
detail: When a variation selector is encountered and no character has been measured yet, the code enters the else branch and accesses spans[-1] without checking if spans is empty, causing an IndexError.

title: Potential IndexError for zero-width character with no prior span
detail: When a zero-width character is processed and spans is empty, the code attempts to access spans[-1], raising an IndexError.
